method.sampling: Actual GLB AnimationMixer interpolation; 241 samples per window, phase step 0.00025. These are not additional authored keyframes.
method.shoulderAxis: Wrist relative to same-side shoulder, projected onto opposite-shoulder to same-side-shoulder unit vector.
method.torsoAxis: Same shoulder-relative wrist transformed by inverse torso world quaternion; right -x / left +x outward for this rig.
method.maximumReturn: Largest later outward coordinate minus any earlier minimum within the window; not cumulative positive travel.
method.thresholds: Regression tolerances for accepted R12, not human biomechanics or realism criteria.
method.limitations: Only lateral wrist return in the stated windows; not full-vector jitter, collision, dynamics or visual acceptance.
